name: media_gen
description: Pheonix Multi-Modal Media Generation Pipeline, Job Queue, Safety Filters, and Gallery

changes: Multi-modal media engines supporting Image, Audio, and Video asset generation
UnifiedMediaGateway dispatching modal requests across specialized engines and provider routes
SafetyModerator screening prompts and generated media against safety and content policies
PromptTemplateRegistry supporting parameterized styles, aspect ratios, and negative prompts
MediaGallery cataloging generated artifacts with cryptographic SHA-256 digests and storage URIs
AsyncMediaJobQueue managing priority, job state lifecycle, and user cancellations
